note.ja: 二次中心FD行列の固有値−4sin²(πk/N)/Δx²をFFTで対角化して拡散を厳密に半刻み進め、反応を各点2×2 Newtonのimplicit midpointで全刻み進めるStrang合成。FFT使用時も空間離散はFDです。未収束・予算超過は失敗とし、濃度のclippingはしません。
note.en: Strang-compose exact half-step diffusion of the FD matrix, diagonalized by FFT with symbol −4sin²(πk/N)/dx², and a full implicit-midpoint reaction step solved by local2×2 Newton iterations. FFT does not change FD space into spectral space. Fail on nonconvergence/budget excess; never clip concentrations.

note.ja: 空間も異なるcosine Fourier–Galerkin＋Radau参照（K32/64/96、cubic投影M=4(K+1)>4K、analytic Jacobian）とraw L1/L2/L∞を比較。参照のK感度とODE公差感度を別検査し、時間次数は同じFD半離散系を別実装Radauで積分した値に対して測定。平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を成分ごとに求め悪い方を採用。反応収支・全step正濃度・初期ゼロのk≥5（本対称性で最初はk6）・線形化との差を記録します。 収束ノルムと参照感度は固定最終時刻で判定し、途中スナップショット誤差は別の推移診断です。
note.en: Compare raw L1/L2/L∞ with a spatially independent cosine Fourier–Galerkin/Radau reference (K32/64/96, cubic projection M=4(K+1)>4K, analytic Jacobian). Separately check K and ODE-tolerance sensitivity. Measure time order against a separately implemented Radau integration of the SAME FD semidiscretization. Norms are per-species mean-absolute/RMS/maximum, then the worse species. Record source/sink balance, every-step positive concentrations, initially absent k≥5 (first allowed k6 here), and departure from linearization. Convergence norms and reference sensitivities are assessed at the fixed final time; intermediate snapshot errors are separate evolution diagnostics.
